text:
sasha_sec: Heads-up — customer X reported suspicious KMS access when spinning up nodes in their private deploy. They saw decrypt requests from a pod that shouldn't have KMS perms.

jay_sre: @sasha_sec can you paste the audit log snippet? :eyes:

sasha_sec: Sure, redacted: 
```
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z audit: svc-account default:app-deploy requested kms.decrypt key=r-priv-01 status=200 resource=pod/app-deploy-7f9d
```

ana_devx: That looks like the app-deploy SA still has broad scope in the cluster rolebinding we pushed last week.

tom_infra: I thought we scoped that to namespace only. I'll pull the yaml.

tom_infra: Here's the offending RBAC (trimmed):
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: app-deploy
  namespace: infra
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: kms-accessor
```

ana_devx: There's the issue — cluster binding. We need to change to RoleBinding scoped to infra namespace and narrow verbs to get/decrypt only.

sasha_sec: Agreed. Proposal:
- Create Role in infra namespace with verbs: get, decrypt on kms.secrets
- Replace ClusterRoleBinding with RoleBinding
- Add audit annotation to rolebindings: redwood.audit/intent=restricted
- Enforce egress netpol to only allow pods to talk to kms-proxy endpoint

jay_sre: For the netpol, recommend explicit CIDR for KMS proxy and deny all other egress. Example:
```
kind: NetworkPolicy
spec:
  podSelector: matchLabels: app: app-deploy
  policyTypes: [Egress]
  egress:
  - to: [{ipBlock: {cidr: 10.3.12.8/32}}]
    ports: [{protocol: TCP, port: 443}]
```

kms-bot: ACTION REMINDER: run key-access audit for key=r-priv-01 across last 7 days — /run-key-audit r-priv-01

ana_devx: Also suggest enabling 'require-authn-for-kms' feature in the private control plane so pods must present SPIFFE identity before proxy will forward.

tom_infra: I'll draft a small patch and a short rollback plan. If we remove cluster binding, any jobs relying on it may fail — plan will include a canary namespace.

sasha_sec: Triage checklist for incident doc:
1) Rotate data-encryption envelope keys for r-priv-01 (generate new DEK, rotate in KMS with staged rollout)
2) Revoke stale serviceaccount RoleBindings
3) Preserve audit logs (+14d) and export to secure bucket
4) Run pentest on netpol to ensure no accidental egress via host network

jay_sre: I'm ok with the plan. @tom_infra can you open a short RFC PR with the YAML + tests? Target deploy window today EOD.

tom_infra: On it. Will include smoke test that fails if any pod can talk to KMS without proper SA scope.

ana_devx: One more: update onboarding docs for private deploys to include the RBAC checklist and a 'least-privilege' snippet.

sasha_sec: Thanks all. If the audit bot shows any further decrypts after changes, we'll escalate to incident-response. :lock:
